title: VSift transcript.get data, brief view v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial transcript.get result asked for with --view brief (0.2.1): transcript-get-data.schema.json with each item reduced to transcript-segment-brief.schema.json and a view member that is always brief. Everything else is the full page's own: the revision block holds once what the full view repeats on every item (revision_id, source_id, source_segment_id, the recognizer's digests, model and decoding profiles), and transcript_coverage says which parts of the range a transcript covers, exactly as in the full view. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is truncated, and its status partial, exactly when transcript_coverage.untranscribed_ranges is not empty. The view is refused with --events jsonl. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, range, revision and view to continue.
